title: Conductor survey output
description: Routing contract with teeth: preferred_next_label restricted to the survey's outgoing edge labels (the fabro-9ec3 planner pattern). A drifted label (node name, invented label) fails validation, burns a repair turn, and never rides the Unrouted catch-all to a green exit.

preferred_next_label.description: The survey's outgoing EDGE labels; never a node name.
